meta.title: Session delete
meta.description: Deletes a session permanently from the sidebar: right-click a session row (or open its "..." menu) and choose "Delete session…", or use the trash button that appears on row hover. Both open a confirmation dialog, then remove the stored chat log, its projection cache, and the workspace entry, and reload the page so the row is gone (a reload discards an unsent draft). A session that is in use is refused — switch to another session first — and a session that still has running work must be archived first, which stops that work. The same operation is exposed to the agent as the session_delete tool. Turning the plugin off restores the stock sidebar and removes the tool.
